fusions.name: Drawing the Venom
fusions.desc: Flicks a barbed feather into the first enemy it meets for 16 damage, using up every affliction you have on it and dealing 60% more for each one drawn out.

fusions.name: Bitter Wingbeat
fusions.desc: A wingbeat deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and leaves them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Moulting Shake
fusions.desc: Shakes up to 2 conditions off you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Above the Miasma
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 8%, and you have 12% poison resistance.
